skill_basis: held-out: L2 logistic regression on binary evidence layers, trained on 559 reported-site clusters in CAF/SSD/SDN outside a 50 km moat round the study area, recipe and settings chosen by spatial 5-fold cross-validation on that training region only, then scored ONCE on the 46 study-area clusters (scripts/regional_mining/nested_cv.py)

truth.sources: data/geology_truth/mining_anchors.geojson (OSM, Crisis Tracker, UCDP GED, USGS) + data/eval/acled_legacy/mine_sites.json (ACLED v8 1997-2017, our labels)

regrid.note: unscored cells are the study area's DR Congo strip: the regional model was trained and applied on CAF, SSD and SDN only, so it says nothing there

question: Do the context layers concentrate the 89 reported mine sites, and if so where else does that context exist?
truth_caveat: Anchors are OSM tags, Crisis Tracker attack records, UCDP GED and USGS points - reachability- and conflict-biased, coordinates sometimes village label positions. A lift means 'reported mines sit on this ground', never 'mines do'. Candidates are places to point imagery and questions, not a treasure map (AGENTS.md invariant 12).

reach_null.method: Target-group background (Phillips et al. 2009): the truth set is reports, not mines, so each signal is also tested against a null that rethrows pseudo-sites where the reporting process demonstrably reaches - a 20 km KDE over ALL Crisis Tracker incidents, UCDP GED events (precision<=3) and OSM places in the AOI, regardless of topic. Votes are decided on q_bh_reach; the uniform columns remain, and their difference is the measured reporting bias of each signal.

composite_method: logit_tuned: reach-weighted L2 logistic regression on binary evidence layers (near/not-near each passing signal), environmental-analogue weighting of training cells (WorldCover land-cover similarity to the study area), l2 and temper chosen by inner CV on the training region; see heldout_source

composite_skill.basis: held-out: model fitted outside XSA, scored once on XSA
held-out: model fitted outside XSA, scored once on XSA
held-out: model fitted outside XSA, scored once on XSA

spatial_cv.method: not applicable: the held-out variant is validated by scripts/regional_mining/nested_cv.py (spatial 5-fold CV on the training region chooses the recipe; XSA is scored once)

basins.method: Grouping unit: HydroBASINS Pfafstetter level-5 sub-basins (Lehner & Grill 2013 v1.c, UNESCO IHP-WINS mirror, data/hydrobasins/hybas5_xsa.json); any level-5 basin holding more than 10% of the AOI is replaced by its level-6 children (hybas6_xsa.json) so one huge basin cannot swallow a fifth of the study area under a single quota. Chosen because alluvial mining and its downstream consequences are organised by drainage, not by administrative or ad-hoc regions. Each basin is named by its dominant named river(s) (most named HydroRIVERS/OSM vertices in park_rivers_hydro; historic 1:250k water labels fill in where no modern name exists; a second name joins at >=50% of the leader). Presentation only - no statistic is computed per basin. Candidates: up to 2 per basin from top-5% ground; watchlist: up to 4 per basin.

abandoned_village_gold_watchlist.hypothesis: 1930s villages with no modern settlement within 3 km, sitting within 5 km of a gold-graded geology contact - the Hofrat el Nahas pattern, stated in report section 4 before testing. Against the uniform null: lift 2.95, q=0.1056 (not significant - but that null lets pseudo-mines land on ground no reporter has ever reached). Against the reach-corrected null (reach_null above): lift 4.06, q=0.073 on n=19 covered clusters - still not significant; listed for imagery follow-up only.
abandoned_village_gold_watchlist.ranking: Ranked by the composite score of the ground each village stands on (ties: closer gold contact first), deduped at 10 km - so the list and the gridded surface agree by construction.

graduated.note: Band membership is the increment (a top10 feature is in the top 10% but not the top 5%), while each tier's capture/lift/p describes the CUMULATIVE top-X% cut (composite_skill). Skill is HELD-OUT (43 XSA clusters never used to fit or choose the model); top35 carries no measured skill and is drawn as graduation only. A feature's band describes the GROUND it stands on, not the feature: a village in top05 is a village on ground that concentrates reported mines, nothing more.
